plan: My goal is to maximize long-term profit. Since this is the first round and I have no history, I'll use a common strategy for private value auctions with 3 bidders: bidding my value. This strategy is theoretically optimal in a first-price sealed-bid auction, but since this is a second-price auction, bidding my value is a dominant strategy, meaning it maximizes my expected utility regardless of what the other bidders do. I will bid $28.0.

I will bid slightly above my value to maximize profit, as I only pay the second-highest bid. Since my value is $23, I'll bid $23.1 to ensure I win if the other bids are below or equal to my value, while minimizing my payment if I win. This strategy aims to secure the item when profitable.

Given this is a first-price sealed-bid auction with payment equal to the second-highest bid, it's a Vickrey auction variant. In such auctions, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy, as it maximizes your utility regardless of other players' bids. My value is $36. I will bid my true value.
